Zaplet is a [[Lightning]] type [[Specialist]] [[Tatari]]. It evolves into [[Synthhog]] at 6 bronze stars.

== Overview ==
Current Description: "Unable to fly yet panics at the slightest movement. As such, Zaplet usually ends up hiding in a dark corner after flapping around and bumping into things."

Zaplet is a purple rarity Tatari.

==Appearance==
A small, round bat with large ears and tiny wings. It has a white underbelly and yellow/orange accents in its ears, wings, and nose.

Zaplet's [[Tatari#Glitter Tataris|Glitter]] form changes its body to turquoise, and orange/yellow becomes pink/peach.

== Evolution Trial ==
Zaplet's evolution trial unlocks once it reaches 6 bronze stars/19 copies. To evolve it into [[Synthhog]] you need to complete the following task:
* In [[Zobo Horde Invasion|Horde Invasion]], upgrade Zaplet to Lvl 5 or above for a total of 1 time(s).

== Trivia ==
* Prior to the update on 3/11/2026, its bio description said: "Is this a bat or a winged piglet with long ears? Either way, adorable!"
